messages:
emma-sales: Quick ask — HaloHealth wants a 2-week POC for halo-13b-custom. They need PHI controls. Can sales/ML/infra/legal confirm: supported variants per deployment mode, KMS/audit options, p95 latency for ~1k-token prompts, and a hosted vs dedicated cost delta?

ben-ml: TL;DR: catalog has halo-13b (fp16) and halo-13b-qlora (8-bit-ish). Hosted currently exposes fp16 only. Dedicated & Private can run both but 8-bit uses alternate kernels and KV layout; expect minor generation drift. Recommend running their prompt set through both variants.

ryan-enginfra: Infra snapshot: Dedicated on A100s with quant kernels gives p95 ~140-260ms for 1k tokens depending on batching. Hosted fp16 p95 typically ~110-190ms. If they need <100ms we should advise sequence truncation or reserved burst capacity.

maria-se: Pricing sketch: Hosted = per-token + request fee; Dedicated = reserved GPU pool monthly. For a light POC (1 A100 equiv) our committed price is roughly $Yk/mo vs hosted variable. I'll confirm exact numbers in DM.

emma-sales: They also need answers for KMS, key rotation, and whether audit logs can show request-level metadata or full payloads. @olivia-legal?

olivia-legal: Private supports customer-managed KMS + full contractual audit logs. Dedicated can integrate with customer KMS for private deployments; on our managed Dedicated we use provider-managed keys but can negotiate. Hosted: no BYOK yet; we have SOC2 and encryption at rest/in-transit. For SSQ Q12 (data locality) we can commit regionally for Private/Dedicated; Hosted depending on availability.

ben-ml: Note on quality: 8-bit quant saves memory/cost but can alter tail behavior. We'll run a 500-1k sample eval from their prompt corpus; can turn around an eval report in ~24 hours after upload.

maria-se: Ops info we need from them: expected qps, average prompt lengths, concurrency targets, and whether they want canary/fallback routing to hosted fp16 if Dedicated saturates. Example fallback config I usually share:

emma-sales: [pasting routes snippet]

ben-ml: Also ask if the POC needs canary rollout (traffic split) or immediate cutover; this affects timing and billing.

ryan-enginfra: If on-prem requested, we'll need GPU model, network egress rules, KMS endpoint, and an install window. I'll share the environment checklist after this thread.

maria-se: I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with customer + sales + ML + infra + legal tomorrow. Invite shortly.

emma-sales: Next steps: 1) I'll request prompt set + qps, 2) @maria-se will confirm pricing, 3) @ben-ml will run evals, 4) @ryan-enginfra share checklist & ops notes, 5) @olivia-legal draft SSQ replies. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ben-ml: ready to run evals once data's in.
yan-enginfra: checklist & runbook will land in #sales in morning.

maria-se: invite sent.

emma-sales: closing the loop — appreciate the quick turnaround.
